newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan ships post gains as investors seek laggards.
newsitem.headline: Japan ships post gains as investors seek laggards.

text.p: Shares in Japan's shipping line and ship building sectors posted gains in the Wednesday morning session, as investors sought lower-priced shares that have lagged behind the market, brokers said.
As of 0056 GMT, the sea transport sector was at the top of the list of gaining sectors, with ship builders ranked third.
Mitsui O.S.K. Lines Ltd added nine yen to 257, with 3.11 million shares traded, the second most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse. Navix Line Ltd gained six yen to 230.
Sasebo Heavy Industries Co Ltd was up 14 yen or 5.96 percent at 249, the second largest percentage gainer.
Hitachi Zosen Corp rose 10 yen to 500.
